# #57786 [Docs] Add model recipes skill

https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/57786 · esmeetu · MERGED · created 2026-09-20T11:54:05Z · merged 2026-10-06T12:40:10Z

## Purpose

Add a `model-recipes` skill for finding how to run a model on specific hardware for a given task. It documents direct catalog queries, variant-specific JSON, task filters, and hardware/strategy command selection, including multi-node and Omni cases. Recipe creation and updates link to `vllm-project/recipes`'s existing `add-recipe` skill so authoring rules stay with their owning repository.

Duplicate check: searched open PRs for `recipe skill`, `model-recipes`, and `"recipes" "skill" in:title`. No matching skill PR was found. Related #57307 implements runtime tuning/sweep tooling under `tools/recipes`, rather than agent guidance for catalog lookup. No issue is linked to this change.

AI assistance was used to write and test this skill. This draft is for human line-by-line review and rerunning the relevant checks before marking it ready.

## Test Plan

- `.venv/bin/pre-commit run --files .agents/skills/model-recipes/SKILL.md .agents/skills/model-recipes/agents/openai.yaml`
- `git diff --cached --check` before committing.
- Ran the skill-creator `quick_validate.py` against `.agents/skills/model-recipes` using `.venv/bin/python`.
- Executed the documented `curl`/`jq` lookup against `https://recipes.vllm.ai/models.json` and fetched `https://recipes.vllm.ai/Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B.json`.
- Exercised 10 read-only request scenarios: model-family lookup, exact FP8 checkpoint, provider listing, H100 selection, four-node topology, Omni text-to-video, missing model, recipe creation/update routing, and an unrelated job-run request. Checked four-node output against the recipes checkout's command generator.

## Test Result

All applicable pre-commit hooks, skill validation, and whitespace checks passed. The current lookup examples return Qwen3.8-27B and its variants. Scenario checks resolved the intended checkpoint/hardware, distinguished generated commands from verified configurations, and routed authoring to the recipes repository. Four-node synthesis produced TP=32 and distinct ranks 0–3 for 4 × 8 H100.

Browser interaction testing could not complete because the browser session was unavailable. No GPU jobs or model evaluations were run; this change adds agent documentation and UI metadata only, with no runtime or model-output changes.

- [x] Human submitter has reviewed every changed line and rerun the relevant checks.

## comments

**sfeng33** (2026-09-30T02:48:06Z):

Probably worth one sentence saying this is lookup only: don't launch `vllm serve` and don't edit the recipe's flags or parallelism. The openai.yaml default prompt ("find a recipe for running my model") makes that ambiguous.

**benchislett** (2026-09-30T03:00:03Z):

Also worth a clear disclaimer that recipes are a validated starting point and not a perfect recipe: recipes are not always tuned for best performance and following a recipe is not a substitute for performance tuning
